title: Reading Path
subtitle: Five reading tracks, piano, guitar, ukulele, Aerophone and rhythm, each with levels, a reading shelf and a level test.
benchmark: ABRSM Grade 6 piano sight-reading; Leavitt Vol. 1 and ABRSM classical guitar Grade 3 to 4; JHUI Books 1 and 2; ABRSM saxophone Grade 5; Reed, Progressive Steps to Syncopation

levels.title: Piano reading 1: hands together at ABRSM Grade 2
levels.goal: Find your level, then read both hands together in time.
levels.adds: Grand staff in one view, D major and E, G minors, 3/4, ties and rests, the habit of a 30 second look.

steps.title: Placement climb
steps.setup: Sight-reading, level climb from Level 2 (Piano Marvel rules).
steps.done: Pass every level-3 rung (top rung D minor) with at most 2 strikes, on two days. If the climb ends in level 2, do steps 2 and 3 first and repeat.

steps.title: Landmarks and ledger lines
steps.setup: Flashcards, play the answer: C major, both clefs, Level 3 range (G2 to E6).

steps.title: New keys
steps.setup: Flashcards in D major and E minor, then Sight-reading Level 3 in D major, keeping time. G minor is not in the drill yet.
steps.done: 95% of cards per key; 80% on 5 of 6 phrases.

steps.title: Hands together, first contact
steps.setup: Sight-reading, piano-4 (hands together), waits for you, 4 bars.
steps.needs: Grand-staff level piano-4 in Sight-reading (ABRSM Grade 2, hands together, 3/4, ties and rests).

steps.title: Hands together in time
steps.setup: Sight-reading, piano-4, keeping time at 60, then 72.
steps.done: 80% on 5 of 6 phrases at 72, on two days.
steps.needs: Grand-staff level piano-4 in Sight-reading (ABRSM Grade 2, hands together, 3/4, ties and rests).

steps.title: 3/4, ties and rests
steps.setup: Sight-reading, piano-4 in 3/4.
steps.needs: Grand-staff level piano-4 in Sight-reading (ABRSM Grade 2, hands together, 3/4, ties and rests).

steps.title: Look, hear, play
steps.setup: A 30 second look with a hum-bar-1 prompt before each piano-4 phrase.
steps.done: 10 phrases with the pause, mean score no lower than without it.
steps.needs: A 30 second look with a hum-bar-1 prompt before each Sight-reading phrase.

steps.title: Follow a line by ear
steps.setup: Ear, Spot the wrong note: major diatonic.

steps.title: Sight-read the shelf
steps.setup: Song Studio, sight-read: one scored pass at 70% of the marked tempo.
steps.done: 3 different shelf pieces at 80% or better on the first pass.
steps.needs: Sight-read mode in Song Studio: a 30 second look, then one scored pass.

steps.title: Read a duet part
steps.setup: Song Studio: Diabelli Op. 149 No. 1, your part against the other. Until the duet partner ships, play with a recording.
steps.done: Through to the end without stopping, 80%.
steps.needs: Duet partner in Song Studio: the app plays the other part while you read yours.

steps.title: Learn one by reading
steps.setup: Song Studio: wait mode to a first full pass, then performance at the marked tempo.
steps.done: One shelf piece at 90% on two days.

shelf.title: For Children Vol. 1 No. 1, Children at Play
Melodious Pieces Op. 149 No. 1 (duet)
shelf.teaches: Duet: read either part, keep going

shelf.title: Let It Be (Big Note Piano)
shelf.teaches: Pop melody, RH over LH roots

levels.test: All piano-4 rungs with at most 2 strikes; one unseen shelf piece at 80% on the first pass; one learned piece at the marked tempo at 90%.

levels.title: Piano reading 2: ABRSM Grade 3
levels.goal: Read outside five-finger positions in keys to three sharps and flats.
levels.adds: A, Bb, Eb majors and B, C minors, 3/8, two-note chords, simple sixteenths, staccato and slurs, a look-ahead habit.

steps.title: Key signatures to three
steps.setup: Flashcards, play the answer, in Bb major; Circle of fifths steps 1 to 4. A and Eb majors and B and C minors are not in the drill yet.
steps.done: 95% of 40 cards per key; circle steps passed.

steps.title: Triads at sight
steps.setup: Flashcards, triads, play the answer, in each key.

steps.title: Scales of the new keys
steps.setup: Scales, piano, hands together, one octave at 80 (ABRSM Grade 3 speed): A, Bb, Eb majors, then B and C harmonic minors.
steps.done: Clean run in each key on two days.

steps.title: Leaving the position, first contact
steps.setup: Sight-reading, piano-5, waits for you.
steps.needs: Grand-staff level piano-5 in Sight-reading (ABRSM Grade 3, 3/8, sixteenths, two-note chords).

steps.title: In time
steps.setup: Sight-reading, piano-5, keeping time at 66, then 80.
steps.done: 80% on 5 of 6 phrases at 80, on two days.
steps.needs: Grand-staff level piano-5 in Sight-reading (ABRSM Grade 3, 3/8, sixteenths, two-note chords).

steps.title: 3/8 and sixteenths
steps.setup: Sight-reading, piano-5 in 3/8. Rhythm reading 4 first.
steps.needs: Grand-staff level piano-5 in Sight-reading (ABRSM Grade 3, 3/8, sixteenths, two-note chords).

steps.title: Look ahead
steps.setup: A look-ahead mask: played notes hide, 2 beats ahead visible.
steps.done: 80% on 5 of 6 piano-5 phrases with the mask.
steps.needs: A look-ahead mask in Sight-reading: played notes hide, only the next beats show.

steps.title: Sight-read the shelf
steps.setup: Song Studio, sight-read: a 30 second look, then one scored pass.
steps.done: 4 different shelf pieces at 80% first pass.
steps.needs: Sight-read mode in Song Studio: a 30 second look, then one scored pass.

steps.title: Duet secondo
steps.setup: Song Studio: Diabelli Allegro alla Turca, the secondo part.
steps.needs: Duet partner in Song Studio: the app plays the other part while you read yours.

steps.title: Learn one by reading
steps.setup: Song Studio: wait mode to a first full pass, then performance at the marked tempo.
steps.done: One piece at tempo, 90%, on two days.

shelf.title: Soldiers' March Op. 68 No. 2
shelf.teaches: Dotted rhythms, chords in both hands

levels.test: All piano-5 rungs with at most 2 strikes; one unseen shelf piece (or a Gurlitt Op. 101 piece from IMSLP) at 80% first pass; one learned piece at tempo, 90%.

levels.title: Piano reading 3: chord charts and pop lead sheets
levels.goal: Read a pop chart at sight and play it in a named pattern, then add the melody from a lead sheet.
levels.adds: Chord symbols (triads, sus, add9, slash bass), slash rhythm and hits, 6/8 and 12/8 ballads.

steps.title: Symbol to chord
steps.setup: Voicings, voice leading. Flashing any triad symbol in any inversion is not in the drill yet.
steps.done: Any major or minor triad in any inversion within 2 s, 90% of 40.

steps.title: Closest-position loops
steps.setup: I-V-vi-IV, I-vi-IV-V and vi-IV-I-V in closest position, in C, G, F and D.
steps.done: Each loop 4 times at 80 bpm with no wrong chord, on two days.
steps.needs: Pop chord loops in closest position (I-V-vi-IV, I-vi-IV-V, vi-IV-I-V) in Voicings or Comping.
steps.feeds: Let It Be, Stand By Me

steps.title: Named patterns
steps.setup: Comping patterns over a 4-chord loop at 80.
steps.done: Each pattern over a 4-chord loop at 80 bpm, 90%, on two days.
steps.needs: Named pop patterns in Comping: block quarters, broken 1-5-8-10, ballad arpeggio, pop eighths, push on the and of 4.

steps.title: Generated chart, one chord a bar
steps.setup: Generated chart, one chord a bar (chart-1).
steps.needs: Chord-chart reading in Sight-reading (chart-1 to chart-3), graded by pitch classes per beat.

steps.title: Two chords a bar and hits
steps.setup: Generated chart, two chords a bar with hits (chart-2).
steps.needs: Chord-chart reading in Sight-reading (chart-1 to chart-3), graded by pitch classes per beat.

steps.title: Sus, add9, slash bass, 6/8
steps.setup: Generated chart with sus, add9, slash bass and 6/8 (chart-3).
steps.needs: Chord-chart reading in Sight-reading (chart-1 to chart-3), graded by pitch classes per beat.

steps.title: Hear the loop
steps.setup: Ear: Chords in a key (I, IV, V), then Progression dictation for song loops; Harmony for songs steps 1 to 4.
steps.done: 80% on Chords in a key and on Progressions.

steps.title: Lead sheet: melody RH, roots LH
steps.setup: Song Studio: a shelf lead sheet, right-hand melody graded, left hand on roots.
steps.done: Two shelf songs at 90% at tempo.

steps.title: Lead sheet: melody plus chord in RH, bass LH
steps.setup: Song Studio: a shelf lead sheet, melody plus chord in the right hand, bass in the left.
steps.done: One shelf song at tempo, 90%, on two days.

shelf.title: Stand By Me (lead sheet)
shelf.teaches: I-vi-IV-V, bass riff under the chart

shelf.title: Lean on Me (lead sheet with lyrics)

levels.test: Two shelf charts at sight in a named pattern at 80% first pass; one lead sheet (melody plus chords) at tempo, 90%; one chart-3 chart at 80% first pass.

levels.title: Piano reading 4: ABRSM Grade 4

steps.title: Feel 6/8 first
steps.setup: Rhythm reading 3 (6/8). Until generated read-and-tap ships, Echo and Dictation at the compound level.
steps.done: 75% in Echo and Dictation at compound; then rhythm reading 3 passed.

steps.title: Accidentals and ledger lines
steps.setup: Flashcards with sharps, flats and naturals in a key.
steps.needs: Accidentals in Note reading flashcards (sharps, flats and naturals inside a key).

steps.title: Left-hand patterns
steps.setup: Two hands: Alberti bass at 80, in 4 keys. Waltz bass and broken chords over I-IV-V-I are not in the drill yet.
steps.done: Each pattern at 80 bpm, 90%, on two days.

steps.setup: Sight-reading, piano-6, keeping time; 6/8 at dotted quarter = 52 to 60.

steps.setup: Sight-reading, piano-6 with anacrusis on.
steps.needs: Grand-staff level piano-6 in Sight-reading (ABRSM Grade 4, 6/8, anacrusis, accompaniment patterns).

steps.setup: Song Studio, sight-read: a 30 second look, then one scored pass.
